0022600158.text: The Thunder (4-1, 1-1 on the road) are 2nd in the Northwest and coming off a loss, while the Cavaliers (3-2, 3-0 at home) are 2nd in the Central, 1.5 games back, and also on a one-game losing streak. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back) and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won both matchups in 2025-26, most recently 121-113 in Oklahoma City on February 22, 2026.
